title: chore: add changeset for minor version bump
body:
Adds a changeset to trigger a minor version release across all fixed-group packages.

- All 35 packages are in a single `fixed` group in `.changeset/config.json`, so specifying `@objectstack/spec: minor` bumps them all together (e.g. `3.0.11` → `3.1.0`)
